Given / When: Two concurrent requests with one key and data
Then: One `payment_id`, one initial CREATE

Given / When: Same key; amount changes from 5000 to 6000
Then: `409`; original operation unchanged

Given / When: CREATE timeout, lookup `NOT_FOUND`, single retry also times out
Then: Unknown; exactly two reserved CREATE attempts; no more CREATE

Given / When: First CREATE unknown; retry receives proven nonacceptance with `429`
Then: Remain unknown; no third CREATE

Given / When: First CREATE proven not accepted with `429`; Retry-After=30 seconds
Then: No retry before 30 seconds; same provider key

Given / When: Retry-After delays eligibility past one hour or cutoff
Then: No CREATE; retain review and observation

Given / When: Lookup `NOT_FOUND` after 24 hours
Then: Unknown; no new provider key or CREATE

Given / When: Only overdue review is open; verified success arrives
Then: `SUCCEEDED`; overdue closed; one credit task

Given / When: Overdue and security hold open; success arrives
Then: `SUCCEEDED`; overdue closed, security hold open; credit review

Given / When: Last hold removed from a successful payment
Then: `PENDING`; one logical task, even on repeated command processing

Given / When: Invalid webhook signature with a known payment ID
Then: Payment and holds unchanged; `401` and security event

Given / When: Event over a day old, delivered with fresh valid signature
Then: Business-event age alone is not a rejection reason

Given / When: Valid webhook repeated with new timestamp, same ID and body
Then: `2xx`; no repeated business effect

Given / When: Two different signed payloads with one event ID
Then: Preserve conflict; do not automatically apply second payload

Given / When: Inbox unavailable
Then: `503`; notification is not acknowledged as accepted

Given / When: Concurrent success and `PENDING`
Then: Final success, one posting

Given / When: Concurrent verified success and failure
Then: One final state; conflict open; no automatic posting reversal

Given / When: Balance posting created; response lost; delivery repeats
Then: One posting, then `POSTED`

Given / When: Worker crashes after success commit, before dispatch
Then: Task retained; restart resumes delivery

Given / When: Outbox exists; hold opens before dispatch reservation
Then: No balance call; `REVIEW_REQUIRED`

Given / When: Hold opens after balance call starts; posting is confirmed
Then: `POSTED`; review remains; no promise to revoke the call

Given / When: Two new keys with matching attributes arrive together while the original is unresolved
Then: One operation; second request gets `409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_PAYMENT`

Given / When: New key after 6 minutes; first payment unknown
Then: Still 409; return existing PaymentStatus, no second payment

Given / When: Storage unavailable before attempt reservation
Then: No provider call

Given / When: Worker lost after saving attempt, before network call
Then: Budget slot not automatically restored; unresolved attempt

Given / When: 30 days elapsed, but review open or posting unconfirmed
Then: Do not delete client-key binding

Given / When: Five consecutive balance-service 5xx responses
Then: Breaker open; tasks retained; probe after 30 seconds

Given / When: Workers unavailable for 10 minutes after success
Then: Payment retained; overdue credit counts as an SLO miss if in denominator

Given / When: Each nonfinal state is returned by POST replay
Then: 202 and the complete API-01 DTO; client stops POST and uses bounded GET

Given / When: GET returns a known nonfinal payment
Then: 200 with the same DTO; HTTP 200 is not financial success

Given / When: Duplicate guard rejects a new key
Then: 409 with existing_operation and SHOW_EXISTING_PAYMENT; no new key binding

Given / When: Matching payment is unknown for 24 hours
Then: Guard remains active; no second CREATE due to a new client key

Given / When: Worker read task; hold commits before dispatch authorization
Then: Shared row lock orders commits; no balance call

Given / When: Dispatch authorized; hold commits before physical send
Then: Authorized attempt may execute; no strict revocation claimed

Given / When: Initial balance response is lost; no hold exists
Then: Retry same payment_id; at most one posting

Given / When: Signed webhook has no event_id
Then: 400, no application; trusted lookup for recovery

Given / When: Captured valid delivery replayed within 300 seconds
Then: Same inbox identity; no repeated effect

Given / When: Daily report has no matching row or is incomplete
Then: Keep unknown, guard, owner, and next action

Given / When: Final NOT_EXECUTED covers every attempt and seals reference
Then: FAILED with evidence; atomically release guard and resolve case

Given / When: Daily reconciliation run repeats or unresolved case reaches 7 days
Then: No duplicate resolution effects; age escalates, never fabricates failure
